name: kilt-button
title: Kilt Button
description: Every clickable action in Capy (ui/button.tsx, cva Xk). variant: solid (default plate), soft, ghost (toolbar/icon actions), outline, link, bare, inverse, segmented (inside a Segmented track). intent: neutral/accent (send, primary CTA)/danger. size: xs 24 (message actions), sm 28 (default; top-bar), base 32, lg 44, icon-xs/sm/base square. state is for specimens only; real hover/active/focus also work.
